query: What is the structure of an atom and its subatomic particles?
title: The Structure of the Atom and Subatomic Particles

scenes.title: The Building Blocks of Matter
scenes.narration: Every element in the cosmos is constructed from tiny atoms composed of three fundamental subatomic particles.
scenes.key_takeaway: Atoms consist of protons, neutrons, and electrons.

scenes.title: The Dense Central Nucleus
scenes.narration: At the center lies the dense nucleus of protons and neutrons, holding nearly all atomic mass.
scenes.key_takeaway: Protons and neutrons pack the central nucleus with positive charge.

scenes.title: Quantized Electron Shells
scenes.narration: Electrons orbit the nucleus in quantized energy shells, accommodating two, eight, or eighteen electrons maximum.
scenes.key_takeaway: Electrons inhabit quantized energy levels with maximum capacity 2n^2.

scenes.title: Valence and Chemical Reactivity
scenes.narration: Electrons in the outermost valence shell dictate all chemical reactivity and molecular bonding across the universe.
scenes.key_takeaway: Valence electrons govern chemical reactivity and molecular formation.
